title: Detached houses for sale on owned land, nine areas: lot size from Horry County parcels, year built and lot location from the listing pages; round 7 adds year-built bands, subdivision, heated area and straight-line distance to the ocean shore
status: research data for ledger rows 69 to 73 (round 2) and 75 to 77 (round 7) of batches/2026-10-b/facts/no-hoa-facts.md; rows 75 to 77 pending verification (round 7)
method: Set: every listing in data/no-hoa.json of Property Type Detached in the nine areas (Longs left out) that is not on leased land: 2,620 (693 with no HOA fee, 1,927 with one), the same houses as ledger rows 15 and 17.

Listing pages: each mbcoastalhomes.realgeeks.com/property/<MLS#>/ page re-opened on 2026-10-13, 04:13 to 04:25 UTC (3 at a time; robots.txt allows /property/). Read: the address in the page title, the map point (schema latitude and longitude), Year Built, Lot Location (an MLS field the listing agent fills, for example 'East of Bus 17', 'Oceanfront', 'Oceanview Lot', 'Second Row'), County and Acres.

Parcel match (Horry County only): the county address points (HorryCountyGISApp MapServer layer 22) within 400 m of the listing's map point with the same house number, then the same street name (directions and street types ignored). One PIN only, or the listing is left unmatched. The lot size is that parcel's mapped area (layer 24, Shape.STArea(), square feet in the state plane, divided by 43,560). The listing's own Acres field is not used: it is typed by the agent and is often wrong (MLS 2616795 shows 0.02 acres).
Town: the town-limits layer (layer 31, Municipalities) at the matched address point. 'outside any town' = no town polygon there.
Georgetown County listings (most of Murrells Inlet's) have no parcel match here; their lot sizes are not counted.
Medians and quartiles: linear between values, as in no-hoa.json.

Round 7 fields (same listing pages, same set): builtSince2024 and builtBefore1990 from Year Built; notInSubdivision = the listing's MLS Neighborhood field reads 'Not within a Subdivision'; heatedSqftMedian from Total Heated SqFt (linear median, whole square feet).

Round 7 beach distance: straight-line distance from the listing's map point to the ocean shoreline in Blog-Brain tools/geo/grand-strand.json (OpenStreetMap coastline via the Overpass API, osm_base 2026-07-15, simplified to about 25 to 30 m), on a flat projection at latitude 33.7. withinHalfMileOfBeach = 804.67 m or less; withinOneMileOfBeach = 1,609.34 m or less. The beach here is the ocean shore, not a public access point.
corrections: 2026-10-14 (round 8 verifier): the 5 Lakeside Crossing listings in Conway (MLS 2607950, 2605035, 2521654, 2615675, 2621733) are on leased land in a 55+ community and are left out, as in no-hoa.json ownedLandOnly. Conway and allNineAreas recomputed.
